## What does the pull request do?
<!--- Give a bit of background on the PR here, together with links to with related issues etc. -->
Fixes `CommandBar` dynamic overflow handling for hidden primary commands.

## What is the current behavior?
<!--- If the PR is a fix, describe the current incorrect behavior, otherwise delete this section. -->
Primary commands with `IsVisible="False"` still consume available width and can be moved into the overflow menu. Changing a primary command's visibility also does not recalculate dynamic overflow

## What is the updated/expected behavior with this PR?
<!--- Describe how to test the PR. -->
Hidden primary commands do not consume available width or appear in the overflow menu. Changing `IsVisible` on a primary command immediately recalculates the overflow layout.

## How was the solution implemented (if it's not obvious)?
<!--- Include any information that might be of use to a reviewer here. -->
Dynamic overflow now counts only visible primary commands. `CommandBar` also observes visibility changes for primary commands using the same subscription mechanism used for secondary commands.
